const numTables = buf.readUInt16BE(4); console.log('numTables:', numTables); // Find cmap table let cmapOffset = -1; let cmapLength = -1; for (let i = 0; i < numTables; i++) { const tag = buf.toString('ascii', 12 + i * 16, 12 + i * 16 + 4); if (cmapOffset >= 0) { const cmapVersion = buf.readUInt16BE(cmapOffset); const numSubtables = buf.readUInt16BE(cmapOffset + 2); console.log('cmap version:', cmapVersion, 'numSubtables:', numSubtables); for (let i = 0; i < numSubtables; i++) { const platform = buf.readUInt16BE(cmapOffset + 4 + i * 8); const encoding = buf.readUInt16BE(cmapOffset + 6 + i * 8); const subOffset = buf.readUInt32BE(cmapOffset + 8 + i * 8); console.log(' subtable', i, 'platform:', platform, 'encoding:', encoding, 'offset:', subOffset); if (platform === 3 && encoding === 10) { // Format 12 (segmented coverage) const subStart = cmapOffset + subOffset; } } } } else if (platform === 3 && (encoding === 1 || encoding === 0)) { // Format 4 or Format 12 const subStart = cmapOffset + subOffset; const format = buf.readUInt16BE(subStart); console.log(' format:', format); g < Math.min(nGroups, 50); g++) { const startCode = buf.readUInt32BE(subStart + 16 + g * 12); const endCode = buf.readUInt32BE(subStart + 20 + g * 12); const startGlyph = buf.readUInt32BE(subStart + 24 + g * 12); if (startCode <= 0xe000 && endCode >= 0xe000) { console.log(' FOUND 0xe000 group: start:', startCode.toString(16), 'end:', endCode.toString(16), 'glyph:', startGlyph); } } } } } }  2 >& 1)

Shell(node -e  const fs=require('fs'); const b=fs.readFileSync('assets/pics/yulislogo.ttf'); const numTables = b.readUInt16BE(4); console.log('Tables:', numTables); for (let i = 0; i < numTables; i++) { const off = 12 + i * 16; const tag = b.toString('ascii', off, off+4); const tOff = b.readUInt32BE(off+8); const tLen = b.readUInt32BE(off+12); console.log(tag, 'offset:', tOff, 'len:', tLen); } // check cmap for (let i = 0; i < numTables; i++) { const off = 12 + i * 16; const tag = b.toString('ascii', off, off+4); if (tag === 'cmap') { const cmOff = b.readUInt32BE(off+8); const version = b.readUInt16BE(cmOff); const numSub = b.readUInt16BE(cmOff+2); console.log('cmap version:', version, 'subtables:', numSub); for (let s = 0; s < numSub; s++) { const pID = b.readUInt16BE(cmOff+4+s*8); const eID = b.readUInt16BE(cmOff+6+s*8); const sOff = b.readUInt32BE(cmOff+8+s*8); const fmt = b.readUInt16BE(cmOff+sOff); console.log(' subtable', s, 'platform:', pID, 'encoding:', eID, 'format:', fmt, 'offset:', sOff); if (fmt === 4) { const segCnt = b.readUInt16BE(cmOff+sOff+6) >> 1; console.log(' segCount:', segCnt); const startCodes = []; const endCodes = []; for (let g = 0; g < segCnt; g++) { endCodes.push(b.readUInt16BE(cmOff+sOff+14+g*2)); } const startCodeOff = cmOff+sOff+16+segCnt*2; for (let g = 0; g < segCnt; g++) { startCodes.push(b.readUInt16BE(startCodeOff+g*2)); } for (let g = 0; g < segCnt; g++) { if (startCodes[g] <= 0xe000 && endCodes[g] >= 0xe000) { console.log(' >>> FOUND 0xe000 at seg', g, 'start:', startCodes[g].toString(16), 'end:', endCodes[g].toString(16)); const idDelta = b.readInt16BE(startCodeOff+segCnt*2+g*2); console.log(' idDelta:', idDelta); } } } } } }  2 >& 1)

Shell(node -e  const fs=require('fs'); const b=fs.readFileSync('assets/pics/yulislogo.ttf'); const numTables = b.readUInt16BE(4); console.log('Tables count:', numTables); for (let i = 0; i < numTables; i++) { const off = 12 + i * 16; const tag = b.toString('ascii', off, off+4); console.log(' Table:', tag); } // Dump first 512 bytes as hex to see structure console.log('First 512 bytes:'); for (let i=0; i<512; i+=16) { const hex = b.slice(i,i+16).toString('hex'); const ascii = b.slice(i,i+16).toString('ascii').replace(/[^\x20-\x7E]/g,'.'); console.log(i.toString(16).padStart(4,'0'), hex, ascii); }  2 >& 1)
